label: miso25 pjm lmp import
definition: Replace the PJM import seam's synthetic gas x HR reference price with measured PJM-west border-hub hourly DA LMP (equal-weight mean of CHICAGO GEN / AEP GEN / ATSI GEN hubs, PJM Data Miner). Mirrors the proven CAISO intertie-hub pattern: measured price overwrites ONLY the PJM seam import/export rows after inject_reference_price_mc; SPP/South seams keep gas x HR. All 8 import tranches get the same measured price + hurdle. NO firm floor, NO adder. Fixes the 2025 import under-run (gmModel import 21.4 vs 19.0 actual, was 5.8 keeper); 2024 moves right direction but overshoots (32.4 vs 23.1 actual, was 17.0 keeper); 2023 over-imports (46.7 vs 37.9 actual, was 39.4 keeper). The 2023/2024 overshot is price-correct: measured PJM LMP ($28-29/MWh mean) is cheaper than internal MISO clearing prices, so the LP imports the full capacity; the root cause is the CC over-run inflating domestic supply cost. CC_REGULAR down -3.4/-5.1/-4.3 TWh (right direction); CT_PEAKER unchanged (gated by missing scarcity mechanism). Determination NOT-YET (C1 CC/CT substitution unchanged). Structurally more faithful than keeper (measured price > synthetic estimate, rule #11).
